title_zh: 马来西亚装修预算怎么安排
excerpt_zh: 装修预算应从明确范围、现场情况、材料规格、审批、暂定项目和变更管理建立，而不是套用一个通用平方尺单价。
excerpt_en: Build a renovation budget from confirmed scope, site condition, specifications, approvals, provisional items and change control instead of a generic price per square foot.
content_zh:
直接答案：有用的装修预算不是一个总数，而是一份决策文件。它要分开已确认工程和暂定额度，写明不包含项目，并为开工前无法确认的现场情况保留受控预备金。

使用方法：把下列各项替换为本项目的实际尺寸、明确责任人、获批图纸和书面记录，再用于报价、审批或施工决定。

哪些因素会影响装修预算和工期？

只看面积不足以可靠判断。房屋类型与现况、拆除与保护、水电、防水、泥水、木作、材料等级与供货时间、管理处或业主要求、现场出入和允许施工时段，都会影响最终确认范围。

询价前建议准备项目地点、房屋类型、大约面积、平面图或现场照片、现有问题、必须完成的项目、预算方向和希望使用或入住的时间。

如果多个空间或工种需要一起协调，可先查看我们的吉隆坡与雪兰莪住宅装修规划，了解现场资料、工程范围和报价准备如何衔接。

从一份书面范围开始

列出房间、保留项目、拆除、饰面、水电、定制柜、审批、保护、清洁和交付。所有报价先按同一基准计价再比较。

分开确定和不确定项目

标明已确认选择、暂定金额、业主自购项目和需检查后才能确定的工作。不能把不确定性藏在一个偏低总价里。

预算要包含关联工程

新增柜体可能同时影响插座、灯光、水路、墙面和地面；浴室洁具也可能涉及开口、防水和修补。要核对接口，不只看单个产品。

付款节点要对应证据

合同应写明付款安排、每个节点的完成证据、变更批准方式和记录要求，不要只靠口头沟通。

范围变化时同步更新预测

把批准总额、已确认变更、待决定项目和剩余预备金放在同一份滚动预算里，避免后期选择变成无法解释的超支。

开工或签约前检查清单

  • 统一可比较的书面范围
  • 已确认规格与暂定金额
  • 审批和管理处费用
  • 保护、拆除与清运
  • 变更批准方法
  • 滚动预算与预备金记录

常见问题

只看平方尺单价够吗？

只能作为早期参考，实际预算取决于范围、现场、规格和责任分工。

预备金应该留多少？

没有适用于所有项目的固定比例，应按检查限制和未确定工程的数量决定。

家具家电要算进去吗？

可以列入承包范围，也可以列为业主自购，但总项目预算里必须看得到。

资料来源与适用边界

  • CIDB 业主装修报价指南
  • CIDB 建筑合同指南

资料核对日期：2026 年 8 月 22 日。相关部门、管理处、顾问和产品制造商的要求可能变化；正式决定前请以项目所在地、具体范围和所选产品的最新书面资料为准。
content_en:
Direct answer：A useful renovation budget is a decision document, not one headline number. It should separate confirmed work from allowances, show what is excluded, and leave a controlled reserve for conditions that cannot be confirmed before opening up the site.

How to use this guide: replace every point below with the property's actual dimensions, named responsibilities, approved drawings and written evidence before using it for quotation, approval or construction decisions.

What changes the renovation budget and programme?

Floor area alone is not enough. Property type and condition, demolition and protection, electrical and plumbing work, waterproofing, wet works, carpentry, material grade and lead time, management or landlord requirements, site access and permitted working hours all affect the confirmed scope.

Before requesting a quotation, prepare the project location, property type, approximate floor area, layout or site photos, current problems, required work, budget direction and intended use or move-in timing.

If several rooms or trades need to be coordinated, review our residential renovation planning in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor to understand how site information, scope and quotation preparation connect.

Start with one written scope

List rooms, retained items, demolition, finishes, services, built-ins, approvals, protection, cleaning and handover. Every quotation should price the same baseline before comparisons are made.

Separate fixed and uncertain items

Mark selections that are confirmed, provisional sums, owner-supplied items and work subject to inspection. Uncertainty should be visible rather than hidden inside a low total.

Budget for connected work

A new cabinet may also affect sockets, lighting, plumbing, wall finishes and flooring. A bathroom fitting may require access, waterproofing and making good. Review interfaces, not isolated products.

Use payment milestones tied to evidence

The contract should state the payment schedule, what completion evidence supports each claim, how variations are approved and what records are kept. Avoid relying on verbal changes.

Update the forecast when scope changes

Keep the approved total, committed changes, pending decisions and remaining reserve in one running forecast. This prevents late choices from appearing as unexplained overruns.

Checklist before approval or start

  • One comparable written scope
  • Confirmed specifications and allowances
  • Approval and management costs
  • Protection, removal and disposal
  • Variation approval method
  • Running budget and reserve record

Frequently asked questions

Is a price per square foot enough?

It can be an early reference only. The actual budget depends on scope, condition, specification and responsibilities.

How much contingency is required?

There is no universal percentage for every project. Set it from inspection limits and the amount of unresolved work.

Should furniture and appliances be included?

Record them either inside the contractor scope or as owner-supplied costs so the total project budget remains visible.

Sources and scope boundary

  • CIDB homeowner guidance on quotations
  • CIDB homeowner guidance on construction contracts

Sources checked on 22 August 2026. Authority, management, consultant and manufacturer requirements can change; confirm the latest written requirements for the actual property, scope and selected product before making a final decision.
